title: Positive-degree images detect the invertible-module generation locus
statement: Let f:W→T be a morphism of schemes, A a quasi-coherent graded commutative O_T-algebra, L invertible, and psi_n:f^*A_n→L^n arbitrary degreewise module maps [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sc-invertible-module, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures]. For affine V and a in A_d(V), x belongs to the generator open G_(V,d,a) [def-trf-line-proj-fraction-chart-data] if and only if x lies over V and multiplication by the germ of psi(a) is a bijection from O_(W,x) to (L^d)_x. The union of G_(V,d,a) over all affine V, all d>0 and all a equals the set of x where at least one positive-degree stalk map (psi_d)_x is surjective. No multiplicative laws on psi or finite-generation assumptions are needed. More generally, for any scheme X, module M, open U and section s on U, membership in the ambient generating locus is equivalent to the existence of a neighbourhood B contained in U on which s is a free generator. If these neighbourhoods cover an open G contained in U, the restriction of s to G is a free generator.

proof.text: First identify the ambient generating locus with the existence of a neighbourhood on which the section freely generates, using restriction along the open immersion. The free-generator property is local, so these neighbourhoods also show that the section freely generates on any covered open. The defining generator locus equals the germ-basis locus. A neighbourhood basis gives stalk bijectivity by representing both scalars and module germs on smaller opens. Conversely trivialize the invertible module near x, write the section as alpha times a frame, and use stalk bijectivity to see that the germ of alpha is a unit. Shrink to its basic open to get a neighbourhood basis.

proof.text: Membership in a generator open supplies an element of the tensor-pullback stalk mapping to a basis; all its scalar multiples prove surjectivity. Conversely trivialize L^d near x and take a preimage of its basis under a surjective positive-degree stalk map. The tensor-pullback stalk comparison identifies this preimage with an element of O_{W,x} tensor_{O_{T,f(x)}} A_{d,f(x)}.

proof.text: If the coefficient of every image of 1 tensor a were a nonunit, tensor induction would imply that the image of every tensor has nonunit coefficient: nonunits in a local ring are closed under addition, and any scalar times a nonunit is a nonunit. This contradicts the preimage with coefficient 1. Represent an a with unit image coefficient by a section on an affine neighbourhood of f(x); its image germ is a basis, hence x is in that generator open. Take the union over positive degrees. This uses no finite generation or quasi-coherence.

lean.statement:
theorem lineProj_generation_locus {W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ T)
    (A : RelativeProjAlgebra T) (L : W.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (ψ : ∀ n : ℕ, (tensorPullback f).obj (A.piece n) ⟶ L.tensorPow n) :
    ((⨆ (V : T.affineOpens) (d : ℕ) (_hd : 0 < d) (a : Γ(A.piece d, V.1)),
        lineProjGeneratorOpen f A L ψ V d a : W.Opens) : Set W) =
      {x | ∃ d : ℕ, 0 < d ∧ Function.Surjective
        ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} x).map (ψ d).mapPresheaf)}
